sections.Profile:
Punchy the Clown , produced by Alvin G. and Company in 1993, is a rare pinball machine with only 103 units made. Designed by Michael Gottlieb and Jim Shird, the game features a circus and clown theme aimed at a more casual or family-oriented audience.

- Manufacturer: Alvin G. and Company
- Years made: 1993
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
